s: Dine sukka shettachat sukka ubo t' seipim: sukka sheal gabbe sukka shessekakah shel tachtona hi qarqaitah shel elyona, im yesh ben sekak hattachton liskak haelyon asara tepachim, shezzehu shiur heksher gobah hassukka kemo sheyyitbaer besiman trl"g, veyakol lehishtammesh baelyona bekarim ukesatot velo tippol bassukka hattachtona — haelyona keshera vehattachtona pesula, shenneemar "bassukkot teshebu vego'", chaser va"v sheniyya, mashma sukka achat, velo tachat shene sekakim. Abal im eno yakol lehishtammesh bekarim ukesatot baelyona apillu al yede haddechaq, kevan shehaelyona enah reuya kelal apillu ledirat aray, shehare apillu al yede haddechaq eno yakol lehishtammesh bah bekarim ukesatot — enah niqret sukka kelal, veenah poselet et hattachtona mishshum sukka shettachat sukka. Veken im haelyona enah geboha asara tepachim, o shechammatah merubba mitztzillatah — enah niqret sukka kelal lipsol et hattachtona:

Lepikak im hattachtona hi tzillatah merubba mechammatah beli tzerup tzel sekak haelyona, az hi keshera bekol inyan, apillu im sekak haelyona gaboah yoter meesrim amma miqqarqait hattachtona. Veap al pi shessekak haelyona hu pasul lassukka hattachtona mippene shehu lemala meesrim amma, venimtza shessekak pasul metzel al hattachtona, ukebar nitbaer besiman trk"v shekkol sekak pasul posel sekak kasher shettachtayv — ap al pi ken hattachtona keshera, apillu im sekak haelyon tzillatah merubba mechammatah, shello ameru shessekak pasul posel sekak kasher shettachtayv ella biskak sheppissulo hu mechamat atzmo, kegon mechubbar o dabar sherauy leqabbel tuma, abal sekak shekkasher mechamat atzmo ella sheddabar acher gorem lo lipsol, kegon shemmunnach lemala meesrim amma — eno posel sekak kasher shettachtayv, kevan shehu beatzmo rauy lesikkuk bassukka shettachtayv:

Abal im hattachtona en tzillatah merubba mechammatah ella al yede tzerup tzel sekak haelyona, im sekak haelyona hu lemala meesrim amma miqqarqait hattachtona — hattachtona pesula, sheen sekak pasul mitztarep liskak kasher lehashlim likshiur:

Haoseh sukkato berosh haagala o berosh hassepina, im enah yekola laamod beruach metzuya deyabbasha — pesula, vehayyosheb bah apillu beshaa sheen sham ruach kelal — lo yatza yede chobato, lepi sheenah dira kelal. Abal im yekola laamod beruach metzuya deyabbasha ap al pi sheenah yekola laamod beruach metzuya deyam — keshera, vehayyosheb bah apillu beshaa shehassepina mehalleket — yotze yede chobato, shehassukka enah tzerika lihyot dirat qeba (shettehe reuya leyamim harbeh) ella dirat aray:

Haoseh sukkato berosh haggamal o berosh hailan, sherosh hailan hu qarqait sukkato, veasa sham mechitztzot vesikkek al gabbehen — keshera. Veen olin lah beshabbat veyom tob, sheasur lehishtammesh bebaale chayyim ubimchubbar laqqarqa beshabbat veyom tob kemo shennitbaer besiman shl"v, veen dochin apillu shebut shel dibre soperim mippene qiyyum mitzvat sukka, mittaam shennitbaer besiman tqp"v, ayyen sham:

Vaapillu im hassukka hi al haaretz ella shehaqqanim shel sekak mesummakin al hailan — asur liknos letokah beshabbat veyom tob, gezera shemma yishtammesh behassekak sheyyanniach sham chapatzayv, o yitleh bo shum dabar venimtza mishtammesh bitzdade hailan, dehaynu hassekak shessamuk al hailan niqra tzedade hailan, veasur lehishtammesh bo beshabbat veyom tob kemo shennitbaer besiman shl"v:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bayyamim harishonim shehayu regilim lehishtammesh bassekak lehanniach velitlot sham cheptzehem, abal akshav sheen regilin bekak — en chosheshin lekak, ulepikak yesh lehattir likkanes letokah beshabbat veyom tob. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla en lismok et hassekak al hailan, sheen maamidin et hassekak lekattechilla ella bedabar harauy lesikkuk kemo sheyyitbaer besiman trk"t, ayyen sham hattaam:

Veim rashe haqqanim shel hassekak nismakim al rosh haggamal — apillu bediabad pesula, lepi sheen lah qeba, shehare haggamal sopo lelek mikkan veyippol hassekak. Velo hikshiru sukka berosh haggamal ella im ken sikkek al gabbe mechitztzot sheal gabbe haggamal, shehassukka mittaltelet im haggamal:

Haoseh miqtzat qarqait sukkato umiqtzat dopnoteha al rosh hailan umiqtzat qarqaitah umiqtzat dopnoteha al dabar acher vesikkek al gabbe haddepanot, im hi asuya beinyan sheim yinnatel hailan tishshaer hi omedet al haddabar acher velo tippol — muttar laalot lah beshabbat veyom tob besullam shello al derek hailan, veim lav — en olin lah beshabbat veyom tob, dekevan shessemikatah al hailan — nimtza keshenniknas letokah mishtammesh bitzdade hailan kemo shebbearnu lemala:
